question: Can one bounded direct-weight update model, conditioned only on the previous fully observed public action-consequence transition, predict new consequences at identical current public inputs better than static weights across persistent hidden-regime changes, while exposing failure under memory-uninformative rapid switching?
hypothesis: For authored persistent two-regime 4D continuous source-free transitions with identical public state/action inputs but hidden regime-specific output offsets and observation noise, one shared four-by-four recursive least-squares lag-residual program trained on only past public transitions will lower held later-step RMSE relative to the fully fitted static WSP160 model by at least 0.05 for all 3 independent seeded simulation replicas; it will numerically tie an independently solved same-information lag-ridge control (<=1e-8). Historical context reset is necessary; an iid-per-step regime stress may show negative transfer and MUST be recorded, not hidden or retuned. First-of-episode forecasts cannot use future feedback. No direct-weight superiority or original-source scientific first use is claimed.

frozen_design.split: For each seeded replica, generate 32 FIT episodes each 16 steps with independently sampled but within-episode persistent hidden regime ±1, then 16 held VALID episodes each 16 steps using independent generator continuation; same observed public state/action support but distinct transition noise and episodes. Each episode has public terminal flag at step16. Also 16 16-step IID stress episodes where hidden regime independently resamples every step. No actual virgin original source, and all VALID predictions are strictly prequential based only on preceding public witness.
frozen_design.ordering: Freeze prereg alone before source, fixture and primary CI. Generate all source-free FIT and VALID streams, fit STATIC WSP160 from only FIT public transitions, then fit HISTORY 4x4 RLS from pairs of *preceding* and current FIT public residuals within each episode. On VALID: predict before observing current outcome, use only last public record inside same episode. Score first-step separately, later-step, all-step, iid stress, independent matched controls. Never pass source regime labels to learner or conventional controls. No post-score tuning.
frozen_design.data_budget: Per seed 512 FIT public transitions (32x16), 256 persistent VALID (16x16) and 256 independently iid-switch stress transitions (16x16), zero original CausalGym resets/steps/do/ctf_do, no protected first-use, no hidden simulator values passed to models. 3 seeds x same rule family but truly disjoint noisy episodes, not three independent real source environments.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib, 4x4 coefficient/covariance =32 floating parameters for history update plus inherited WSP160 4x10/10x10 static model; <=2048 FIT rows/model, 3 frozen seeds, focused tests and mandatory full exact candidate Linux/Windows root+NKR05 regression and G29. No new runners, paid APIs, GPU, scheduler, controller.
frozen_design.capacity: ONE frozen WSP160 static 4D direct-program baseline + ONE bounded 4x4 lag-residual RLS inside the same opt-in history-conditioned predictor (no per-family expert bank, no source family labels); 4x4 inverse ridge covariance, λ=1, max 2048 pairs; immutable updates, exact canonical integrity-bound cold checkpoint. Strong comparators may use same FIT public data and identical one-previous-public-transition input.
frozen_design.evaluator: For VALID persistent sourcefree episodes compute RMSE STATIC, history direct RLS, fully trained independently implemented Gaussian-elimination lag ridge with SAME STATIC predictor, one-step public last-residual carry, first-of-episode only, and history-shuffled negative; for iid switch stress compare full and later-step RMSE with static. Record true nonregression or regression without post-hoc thresholds. Check max forecast gap to conventional same-features lag ridge <=1e-8, exact checkpoint cold/restart and caller-defined public episode-boundary reset, privacy, malformed/NaN and provenance.

controls: Independent conventional fully fitted 4x4 lag-residual ridge from the exact same FIT public history/response pairs and the same baseline, Gaussian elimination, expected numerical tie
Last-public-residual carry predictor with no trained lag weights, same baseline; tests whether trained direct weights add anything above cheap public history
Source-blind STATIC WSP160 predictor fit on same FIT rows, no public history
Public-history shuffled across FIT/VALID episodes negative control; genuine historical alignment should outperform shuffled
IID hidden regime redraw every step stress; memory regressing versus static >0.01 RMSE is a frozen robustness NO-GO rather than silent success

First-of-episode none history cannot access previous episode or current outcome; private `u_wind`, family label, future/public target leakage, invalid state/action, incorrect previous terminal, tamper and unqualified source access fail closed

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING_PUBLIC_HISTORY_SUPPORTED iff all 3 seeds native history later-step persistent RMSE improves vs static by >=0.05, matches fully fitted independent lag-ridge forecasts to <=1e-8, first step (no history) equals static byte-exact, history shuffled negative cannot beat correctly ordered history, all source-only integrity tests and final full exact Linux/Windows root+NKR05/G29 PASS. The conventional control tie is NOT scientific superiority. SCIENTIFIC_PASS always FALSE.
classification_rules.mixed: If fitted native history improves persistent case but iid stress history regret >0.01 RMSE, explicitly classify DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO_FOR_UNKNOWN_REGIME_PERSISTENCE even if engineering metrics PASS; no promotion or model-wide deployment. If full exact qualification unavailable, ENGINEERING_UNVERIFIED regardless of synthetic scores.
classification_rules.negative: If persistent later-step improvement <0.05 for any seed, same-feature conventional parity fails, shuffled history outperforms ordered, or forbidden future/private evidence reaches model, record DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO and preserve scored evidence, no tuning.
classification_rules.invalid: Any upstream original reset/step/do/ctf_do, supplied hidden regime or simulator internals to predictor, score-driven post-result source changes, direct edit to WSP159–162/CKAD, owner/controller mutation, failure to pin source provenance.
